decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf remains close to the firm's core offerings and inexpensive to keep, so the option stays open while demand uncertainty persists.

The guided historic mill tour builds on existing tour and café operations, and although pandemic-related uncertainty remains, the marginal cost of holding the option is low enough to avoid abandonment.
As a sweet pastry close to established confectionery, keeping it on the market costs little and no negative signal has yet ruled out future returns.
The crusty farmhouse bread is close to the core bakery range and its prospects remain uncertain, so the low holding cost justifies retaining the option.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen is a flagship product with a gold award, which reduces uncertainty about its value and supports continued commitment.
The premium Christmas stollen has also received a gold award, signalling realized value and making the option worth exercising rather than abandoning.
